correctness.rationale: The radius-three local dependence gives a bijection from all indexed coherent ring words to closed walks in the 729-vertex six-word overlap graph. A complete 2187-window enumeration and SCC reduction leave a 65-vertex, 118-edge cyclic component. Its integer characteristic polynomial is reconstructed from all 65 exact walk traces by Newton identities, yielding the four-term all-length recurrence; reflection and an exhaustive two-cell alternating quotient prove the two directional sets intersect only in three uniform configurations. Self-contained check_transfer.py and independent check_direct.py were executed with matching outputs. The Perron law follows from the strongly connected component with a loop. This is a proof for every n>=3; n<=10 direct enumeration is an independent finite cross-check only.
